goal: Issue #414 slice S3 (Spec docs/specs/host-neutral-adapter-core.spec.md, D2, D7). The host-neutral body of ClaudeRuntime moves to plugins/immune-brain/runtime/host-core/runtime.ts as HostRuntime configured by a HostRuntimeProfile (host id, native confirmation reference, AssuranceHostPort and its observe, probe, lane relay factory); ClaudeRuntime and AntigravityRuntime each compose it and neither extends the other. NativeAuthorityError is defined once in host-core/interaction.ts. The host-to-host baseline drops the kernel_ports and interaction edges, leaving only antigravity/mcp_server -> claude/mcp_server. Behavior preserved; no user-visible change.

acceptance.assertion: Spec S3 AC1 (BR-REQ-5; D2, D7). Done looks like: no adapter runtime extends another and the boundary baseline loses two edges. Seam: tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts over the real sources. Positive: BASELINE has exactly one entry, 'plugins/immune-brain/runtime/antigravity/mcp_server.ts -> plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server', and the observed edges equal it. Negative: a fixture edge outside the baseline is reported unexpected, and no file under plugins/immune-brain/runtime contains 'extends ClaudeRuntime'. Bound: a baseline entry with no observed import is reported stale.

Spec S3 AC2 (BR-REQ-5; D7). Done looks like: both runtimes are the same HostRuntime with different profiles. Seam: tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts describe 'runtime composition', constructing ClaudeRuntime and AntigravityRuntime over isolated repositories with the same scripted task. Positive: driving each through enrollment, QA and review_ready yields equal Kernel projections apart from the Host identity, which is 'claude-code' and 'antigravity' respectively, each with its own native confirmation reference; an Antigravity verifier event passed to observeAntigravity reaches that runtime's ReviewHost. Negative: a native refusal raised by either runtime is an instance of the NativeAuthorityError exported by runtime/host-core/interaction.ts and keeps its error code. Bound: exactly one file under plugins/immune-brain/runtime declares class NativeAuthorityError, and it is runtime/host-core/interaction.ts.

Spec S3 AC3 (BR-REQ-5; D7). Done looks like: existing callers of ClaudeRuntime and AntigravityRuntime keep working with at most import changes. Seam: the existing runtime suites tests/claude-host-authority.test.ts, tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts and tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts. Positive: their enrollment, QA, Review and batch tests pass. Negative: their existing refusal tests (for example run_entry_required and probe refusals) still refuse with the same codes. Bound: the AntigravityRuntime host probe tests still observe the Antigravity probe, not the Claude one.
